question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:

 REPEAL
solution:
The correct answer is: **Enforce**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Repeal"** means to revoke, cancel, or annul a law, decision, or agreement. (रद्द करना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The government decided to repeal the controversial tax law after public protests.
 
 

 
• **"Enforce"** refers to the act of ensuring compliance with a law, rule, or regulation, or making something happen by authority or force. (लागू करना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The police enforce traffic laws to ensure road safety.
